RULE: the card goes in the box only — eBay bans off-eBay links or addresses in listings, descriptions, messages and feedback, and that's how accounts get restricted.

ETSY AI POLICY (22 Oct 2026): Etsy now bans AI-generated functional instructions (patterns, recipes, manuals, how-to e-books) and wants an unedited real photo on most listings — but print-on-demand may use the maker's stock mockups and digital downloads only need a preview of the pages, so the 106 Printify listings and the printables are fine. The two Claude AI Guides were the banned category, so they are Inactive on Etsy (still on the site); the 23 Guides Bundle got a 'reading, not instructions' line. RULE FROM NOW: nothing on Etsy that teaches a task step by step, and keep the 'made with AI' disclosure on the printables (it is required, not a risk). Bot-generated listings are also banned, so every Etsy listing stays hand-checked before Publish.

THE £100k QUESTION (asked 8 Oct 2026): £100k a year is ~14 orders a day at ~£20 each, needing ~700–1,400 visitors a day at normal conversion; the shop gets a handful. Three things move it — paid traffic (only once a £40+ product exists), earned traffic (slow, needs a face), and higher-value products (organisation packs, a £25–£40 Bespoke Planner, a workbook/course). The 90-day plan above tests all three
